zeelin-search-pro 1.0.2

- Updated API workflow instructions in the documentation for greater accuracy.
- references/zenlin_search_api.md was modified (details not shown).
- Minor adjustments to templates/config.json to improve configuration clarity.
- No functional logic changes; this update focuses on documentation clarity and config guidance.

- 技能名称由 "zeelin-search" 更新为 "zeelin-search-pro"。
- 其余内容无变更，功能和流程保持一致。
- 本次仅为技能名称调整，无功能新增或逻辑变动。

Initial release of zeelin-search-pro skill.

- Enables users to perform data queries via the Zeelin Search API using natural language triggers and presents results in a user-friendly format.
- Automatically checks if Zeelin_Api_Key is configured before API calls; if not, provides detailed, clear instructions for configuration using a dynamic file path.
- Transforms user questions from natural language to JSON, and then sends authenticated API requests, showing request parameters and results (or errors) clearly.
- Always provides feedback to the user, displaying either results (summarized and detailed) or helpful error information and suggestions.
- Stores each query’s results as a timestamped JSON file in the user’s directory and informs the user of the file location.
